steps.title: Distance is a small effect
steps.say: Earth is actually a bit farther from the Sun in northern summer, but only by about 3%. That difference is too small to cause the seasons.

ops.text:
Distance changes only about 3% over the year,
so it is not the main cause.

steps.title: Tilt decides the sunlight
steps.say: In northern summer the northern half leans toward the Sun. Sunlight hits it more directly and the days are longer, so it gets hotter.

ops.text:
Northern summer:
the north leans toward the Sun
